answer: Require each agent to stake a small refundable deposit before it can transact, with the deposit slashed if peers prove fake activity. New identities start with a low trust cap that rises only through verified work over time, so a zephyr of cheap clones cannot wander into the market and buy reputation overnight. An opal-like attestation record — a signed, append-only history of completed jobs — lets others check whether an identity earned its standing or was minted yesterday.
